title.zh: Hall 双流体压强状态闭合

summary: Assemble a caller-supplied total gyrotropic pressure law, quasineutral ion/electron densities, electron pressure components and electrostatic potential into a broadcast two-fluid state for a reduced Hall closure.

identity.relation: Total gyrotropic pressure and prescribed species profiles to an explicit two-fluid pressure and density state
identity.direction: (magnetic_field, psi, pressure_law, ion_density_m3, electron_pressure_pa, electrostatic_potential_v, optional species pressure components) -> total, ion and electron pressures, equal ion/electron number densities, and electrostatic potential
identity.definition: Broadcast B and psi to one shape, evaluate pressure_law(B, psi) for p_parallel and p_perpendicular, and broadcast all supplied profiles onto that shape. Set electron_density=ion_density. Absent electron parallel/perpendicular components each default to electron_pressure; absent ion components are the respective total pressure minus the electron component. Explicit ion components are accepted independently and are not checked to sum to total pressure. Reject negative ion density, electron scalar/component pressures and ion component pressures; no positivity check is applied to the total pressures themselves.
identity.model: Prescribed gyrotropic total pressure with an explicit single-ion/single-electron bookkeeping state; no pressure law, equation of state, force balance or potential is solved here.
identity.geometry: Caller-supplied scalar or broadcast array of magnetic-field magnitude and flux coordinates; the implementation does not construct an R-Z mesh.
identity.coordinates: Profile callables receive jointly broadcast magnetic_field and psi arrays; their outputs and fixed profiles broadcast to that common shape without coordinate-axis validation.
identity.boundary: No physical boundary condition is applied. The default species split is algebraic and fails when it gives a negative ion component; explicit ion pressures can override that split without an equality check.
assumptions: magnetic_field is a compatible field magnitude in tesla and psi denotes one common caller-defined flux coordinate; its normalization is not checked.
The pressure law returns total parallel and perpendicular pressure in Pa on the supplied state.
Equal returned ion and electron number densities express a singly charged quasineutral state; the function does not derive charge state or verify a physical neutrality model.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Magnetic-field magnitude supplied to the pressure law and profile callables.
inputs.shape: scalar or array, jointly broadcast with psi
inputs.constraints: Finite after joint broadcasting; no positive-field check.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller-defined flux coordinate supplied to the pressure law and profile callables.
inputs.shape: scalar or array, jointly broadcast with magnetic_field
inputs.constraints: Finite after joint broadcasting; coordinate normalization and monotonicity are not checked.

inputs.name: pressure_law
inputs.description: Callable returning total gyrotropic p_parallel and p_perpendicular fields.
inputs.units: inputs T and caller-defined flux coordinate; outputs Pa
inputs.shape: callable of (broadcast magnetic_field, broadcast psi) returning a dictionary
inputs.dtype: Python callable returning a dict with real array-like values
inputs.constraints: Dictionary must contain p_parallel and p_perpendicular, each finite and broadcastable to the common shape. Total pressures are not checked for nonnegativity.

inputs.name: ion_density_m3
inputs.description: Ion number density, or callable of magnetic_field and psi producing it.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like
inputs.constraints: Every resulting value must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: electron_pressure_pa
inputs.description: Electron pressure baseline, or callable of magnetic_field and psi producing it.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like
inputs.constraints: Every resulting value must be finite and nonnegative.

inputs.name: electrostatic_potential_v
inputs.description: Prescribed electrostatic potential, or callable of magnetic_field and psi producing it.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like
inputs.constraints: Every resulting value must be finite; no potential solve is performed.

inputs.name: ion_p_parallel_pa
inputs.description: Optional explicit ion parallel pressure overriding total minus electron parallel pressure.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like
inputs.constraints: If supplied, finite and nonnegative; no check that it and electron_p_parallel sum to p_parallel.

inputs.name: ion_p_perpendicular_pa
inputs.description: Optional explicit ion perpendicular pressure overriding total minus electron perpendicular pressure.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like
inputs.constraints: If supplied, finite and nonnegative; no check that it and electron_p_perpendicular sum to p_perpendicular.

inputs.name: electron_p_parallel_pa
inputs.description: Optional electron parallel pressure; defaults to electron_pressure_pa.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like

inputs.name: electron_p_perpendicular_pa
inputs.description: Optional electron perpendicular pressure; defaults to electron_pressure_pa.
inputs.shape: scalar, array or callable output broadcastable to common shape
inputs.dtype: real array-like or Python callable returning real array-like

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Total parallel pressure returned by pressure_law.
outputs.constraints: Finite; may be negative because no total-pressure sign check is applied.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Total perpendicular pressure returned by pressure_law.
outputs.constraints: Finite; may be negative because no total-pressure sign check is applied.

outputs.name: electron_density
outputs.description: Copy of the ion number density under the implemented single-charge neutrality assumption.
outputs.constraints: Exactly the same array value as ion_density.

outputs.name: electron_pressure
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; can differ from explicitly supplied electron components.

outputs.name: electron_p_parallel
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; defaults to electron_pressure.

outputs.name: electron_p_perpendicular
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; defaults to electron_pressure.

outputs.name: electrostatic_potential
outputs.constraints: Finite; no consistency with pressure gradients is checked.

outputs.name: ion_p_parallel
outputs.description: Ion parallel pressure, explicit or total minus electron parallel component.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; explicit values need not sum with electron component to total pressure.

outputs.name: ion_p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Ion perpendicular pressure, explicit or total minus electron perpendicular component.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; explicit values need not sum with electron component to total pressure.

preconditions: The prescribed pressure law and profiles describe one compatible physical state and return Pa, m^-3 and V values in the declared roles.
All values are finite and broadcast onto the common magnetic_field/psi shape; default ion components remain nonnegative or explicit components are supplied.
supported: Array or callable species profiles over the common field/flux shape.
Default total-to-species pressure split or independent explicit ion/electron parallel and perpendicular components.
excluded: Computing an equilibrium, potential, pressure law or Hall current from first principles.
Enforcing total pressure equality when explicit ion components are provided, a multispecies charge sum or physical axis alignment beyond NumPy broadcasting.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for nonfinite magnetic_field/psi, negative checked moments, or a profile that cannot broadcast; raises FloatingPointError for nonfinite pressure or profile values. A noncallable pressure_law or non-dictionary result raises TypeError; missing pressure keys raise KeyError. Numeric conversion and initial broadcasting can also raise TypeError or ValueError; profile callbacks propagate their exceptions.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: No iterative runtime is used. The function does not check sum consistency for explicitly supplied components or physical compatibility of callback-produced arrays.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no solver iteration is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Validation or callback failure returns no mapping; a successful call returns all ten fields.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel-maintained relation corresponding to a saved Pleiades L1 Hall two-fluid pressure-state operator and maintained direct regressions. Historical source/admission labels are development provenance, not current SciRel expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 operator description and implementation

python.signature: close_hall_two_fluid_pressure(magnetic_field, psi, pressure_law, ion_density_m3, electron_pressure_pa, electrostatic_potential_v, ion_p_parallel_pa=None, ion_p_perpendicular_pa=None, electron_p_parallel_pa=None, electron_p_perpendicular_pa=None)

example.description: Assemble a broadcast Hall state with the default algebraic ion pressure split.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.closures import close_hall_two_fluid_pressure
def law(b, psi):
    return {'p_parallel': 5.0 + b + psi, 'p_perpendicular': 4.0 + b + 2.0*psi}
r = close_hall_two_fluid_pressure([[1.0, 2.0]], [[0.2, 0.4]], law, 1.0e18, 1.0, 3.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['p_parallel'], [[6.2, 7.4]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['ion_p_parallel'] + r['electron_p_parallel'], r['p_parallel'])
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['electron_density'], r['ion_density'])
example.expected: The total parallel pressure is [[6.2, 7.4]] Pa; default species components sum to it and the two number-density arrays agree.

scope: Broadcast law/profile evaluation, default electron and ion pressure decomposition and equal returned species densities.
Rejection of a negative derived ion pressure component.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel regressions establish the selected two-cell values, callable profiles, default component split and one negative-moment rejection. They do not verify arbitrary user pressure laws, explicit component-total consistency, all broadcast shapes, a physical Hall force balance or current, or current expert recognition.
known_limitations: The pressure law, electrostatic potential and profile alignment are caller supplied; successful broadcasting cannot establish one physical coordinate frame.
Explicit ion components may disagree with total minus electron components without being rejected.
No total-pressure sign or physical gyrotropy validity test is performed.
Public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
